# Vendored FFmpeg master headers (headers only) — N-122742-ga7522f3fef

Used by `thumb_backend_mpv.cpp` to call MPV's FFmpeg, which is already inside the APK
(`io.github.abdallahmehiz:mpv-android-lib:0.1.12`: `libavcodec.so` / `libavutil.so` / `libswscale.so` /
`libswresample.so`, whose binaries carry "FFmpeg version N-122742-ga7522f3fef"), through `dlopen`/`dlsym`.
Nothing here is compiled into a second FFmpeg; no FFmpeg code is linked.

- Source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg commit `a7522f3fefa719be687f4627631ac6e5e481ef4c` (RELEASE `8.0.git`),
  headers only: the 33 files `thumb_backend_mpv.cpp` includes transitively (from `clang -MM`, both ABIs).
- `libavutil/avconfig.h` is generated by FFmpeg's `configure`; hand-written here for arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a
  (little-endian, fast unaligned access). It does not change any struct layout.
- Versions: libavcodec 62.23.103, libavutil 60.25.100, libswscale 9.3.100.
- Licence: LGPL-2.1-or-later (see `COPYING.LGPLv2.1`).

**The backend relies on these structs matching MPV's FFmpeg.** It checks `avcodec_version()`,
`avutil_version()` and `swscale_version()` at run time and refuses any library whose MAJOR differs from these
headers (FFmpeg keeps public struct layouts stable within a major); the shim then falls back to the FFmpeg 6.0
backend. After an mpv-android-lib update with a new major, refresh these headers from the matching commit.
